concerns.text: FR-009 (Makefile orchestration of all steps) is not referenced in any phase; the plan does not describe the Makefile target structure.
FR-010 (JSON‑Line logging of all actions) is absent from the phase mapping; no plan element explicitly guarantees logging.
FR-011 (production of `predicted_ppi_<species>.tsv` with required columns) is not listed in any phase; the plan does not state the edge‑list file format requirement.
FR-013 (schema validation of predicted edge list) is missing from the mapping; no phase claims to perform contract validation for edges.
FR-014 (batch‑effect correction when multiple GEO series are combined) is not covered; the plan does not allocate a phase for batch correction.
FR-017 (post‑target verification of required output files) is omitted; no phase mentions a verification step after each Make target.
FR-023 (correlation‑threshold sensitivity analysis) is not assigned to any phase; the plan only mentions sensitivity analysis in the summary but does not map it.
FR-026 (construct‑validity justification with literature citations) is absent from the phase mapping; the plan does not ensure this justification is produced.
